title: Master UI contract
description: What a stylesheet promises: its classes, where they go, the states it draws, the properties it reads and the smallest markup that uses it. A contract sits beside its stylesheet and is the one source for the tests, the documentation tables, the registry and the checker.

name.description: The slug: the file name of the stylesheet without its extension.

instead.description: Neighbors that are the right choice in another situation.

composes.description: Other contracts whose classes this one's markup uses. Their stylesheets must be imported too.

script.description: none: every state works without script. optional: a script adds a convenience and the page works without it. required: the pattern has no native element, so a script moves its attributes.

behavior.description: The reference script in behaviors/<behavior>.js that drives the pattern.

keyboard.description: What the keys do once the behavior is attached, or what the native element already does.

platform.description: Platform features used as an enhancement, each with what a browser without it shows.

classes.description: Every class the stylesheet defines, and nothing else.

states.description: The states the stylesheet draws and the attribute or pseudo-class that marks each.

on.description: The class of the element that carries the mark.

mark.description: The attribute or pseudo-class as written in markup or CSS: aria-pressed="true", disabled, :user-invalid, open.

properties.description: The public custom properties. Anything not listed is private and may change.

on.description: The class that declares or reads it. Defaults to the first root.

default.description: The value the stylesheet declares on that class, when it declares one.

example.description: The smallest markup that is correct: it passes the checker with no diagnostics.

kind.description: root: stands by itself. part: lives inside its root. modifier: goes on the same element as its base.

of.description: The root a part belongs to, or the class a modifier goes with. Required for parts and modifiers. A list when it goes with any one of several, such as a modifier shared by two parts.

elements.description: The elements the class may be on. Omit when any element will do.

attributes.description: Attributes the element must carry. true: present with any value. A string: that value. An array: one of those values.

label.description: The element needs an accessible name: text of its own, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title or a label that wraps or points at it.

exclusive.description: A group key. Two modifiers with the same key do not go on one element.

anywhere.description: A part that may stand outside its root, such as a popover the root opens.
